about: The folded Background row of a session's composer band: `backgroundRow(list, clearedAt,
sessionLive)` in backgroundRow.ts. The web, OrbitKit and Android tests load this file by path and
must draw exactly `expect` for every case. Owner decisions D1-D4, E1-E3 (2026-11-17), project
34yq7HVPsPDGBiMEm8sL2.
`list`: the session's entries from GET /sessions/:id/background, cut to the fields the row reads.
`lastUserMessageAt`: the time of the session's last user message (null: none yet).
`lastAgentTurnStartedAt`: when the agent's latest turn started, any turn counting, a wake's included
(null or absent: none). `sessionLive`: whether the session is live. The row's cut-off is the later of
`lastUserMessageAt` and `lastAgentTurnStartedAt` (backgroundRowClearedAt in backgroundRow.ts).
Shown items: running ones (only on a live session) plus ended ones (done, failed, killed) whose
endedAt is later than the cut-off. None shown: `{hidden: true}`, no row and no folded mark.
`label` is "Background". `name.mode`: `one` (one item, still) or `rotate` (2+ running: the running
items newest started first, perNameMs 3000 per name, changeMs 300 per change). A failure changes
neither (E2, revised 2026-11-21): the person can do nothing about it. With nothing running the last
to end is named, failed or not. With one running and others ended, the running one is named.
An item's name is its description (truncate `tail`), else its command (truncate `middle`).
`mark`: running = spinner, done = check, failed = cross, killed = stop icon.
`countParts` / `countLine`: only when more than one item is shown and some run: "N running"; a
failure is never counted (E2); null otherwise.
`accessibilityLabel`: "Background processes, " + countLine, or the one named item's name.
`covers` tags each case with the rules it pins; the shared test requires every tag in `rules`.
`events`, where present, is the session's transcript the clients read `lastUserMessageAt` from: every
client's own reader must return exactly the case's `lastUserMessageAt` from it (the newest user turn
the person typed; wake notes, watch wakes and session-to-session messages do not count).

rules.endedAfterLastUserMessage: An ended item is shown only if it ended after the cut-off: the later of the last user message and the agent's latest turn start.
rules.label: The visible label is "Background".
rules.single: One shown item is drawn as its name and status mark.
rules.nameFallback: Name = description (tail truncation), else command (middle truncation).
rules.countLine: The count line appears only when more than one item is shown and some run, as "N running".
rules.rotation: Names rotate newest started first, 3000 ms / 300 ms, while 2+ run, a failure shown or not.
rules.failureNotCounted: A failure is neither counted nor pinned: it keeps its cross only where it is named.
rules.nothingRunningLastEnded: Nothing running: the last ended is shown, failed or not.
rules.a11yName: Accessibility label "Background processes, " + the one name.
rules.notLive: A non-live session's stale running items are dropped.
rules.sessionMessage: A message another Orbit session sent (session_send / project_send, a `sessionMessage` card on the turn) is not the person's message: it does not clear an ended item.
rules.wakeTurnClears: A turn the agent opens itself (a wake) starts an agent turn and clears an item that ended before it started.
rules.endedMidTurn: An item that ended during a turn already running stays until the next turn starts.
rules.userMessageClears: The person's next message after the end clears an ended item.
